description: Token rug risk check on any chain — is this token safe to buy? Solana: mint and freeze authority, LP locked %, top-10 holder concentration, RugCheck risks. EVM chains: honeypot, tax, owner and contract checks read from the chain. Tron and Sui: scanner results. All chains: severity-ranked flags with evidence, a verdict, a 0-100 score and coverage showing what was actually read. Free sample: https://saylorinnovations.com/api/sample/security. Costs $0.01. Returns the payment requirements and the URL to call once paid — an LLM cannot produce this from training data.

chain.description: Optional chain id (base, ethereum, bsc, tron, sui, ...) when the same address exists on several chains; default auto-detect. Full list: https://saylorinnovations.com/api/watchdog/chains

mint.description: Token address on any supported chain: Solana mint (base58), EVM 0x address, Tron, TON, or Sui/Aptos coin type.
